verdicts.reason: Both cram every element into a 320x50 strip. The 'Find It Near You' CTA shrinks to a tiny pill that ranks below the headline and the badges, and the body copy is too small to read. A is slightly tidier: the FREE DELIVERY sticker sits fully inside the canvas and the pills line up. In B the sticker is oversized and crowds or clips the right edge, the body copy runs right up to the edge, and the SUMMER ONLY pill is jammed against the text.
